models_evaluated: AI-enabled stethoscope (Eko) with three algorithms for reduced LVEF, atrial fibrillation, and valvular heart disease

links.outcome: Incidence of newly coded heart failure diagnosis, AI stethoscope vs routine care, cluster RCT
links.effect: ITT analysis found no significant difference in heart failure detection (IRR 0·94 [95% CI 0·86-1·02]); no difference in community or hospital diagnoses (p>0·05). Per-use analysis showed higher detection.
links.quote: Intention-to-treat analysis found heart failure detection did not differ between groups (IRR 0·94 [95% CI 0·86-1·02]); with no difference in community-based or hospital-based diagnoses (p>0·05).

screen.reason: Pragmatic cluster-randomized trial evaluating the clinical impact of deploying an AI-enabled stethoscope in primary care compared to routine care alone. It tests the tool's deployment overall rather than comparing outcomes across specific deployment practices or safeguards.
